blocks.html: Features of hall call consoles shall be arranged in accordance with Section 1109.7.2.3. Where an accessibility function button complying with Sections 1109.7.2.2.1 and 1109.7.2.3.1 also serves as the "select" button, the provisions of Section 1109.7.2.3.2 shall not apply.
